w: Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha of the marble murtis of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Ganapatiji and Hanumanji and the canvas murtis of guru parampara at the Shree Swaminarayan Mandir in Fall River.

Swamishri arrived in Vidyanagar in the evening and visited the home of Prabhudasbhai Lalaji Patel - a 93 year old devotee from the time of Shastriji Maharaj. Though he was unconscious, Swamishri, placing his hand on his head, said, "Jai Swaminarayan Prabhudasbhai. Now remember Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. You have been blessed by them with happiness. You have done a lot of seva and pleased Shastriji Maharaj.' Swamishri then garlanded him, placed a teaspoonful of holy water in his mouth and prayed for his moksha. Swamishri then performed the arti and said, "Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj, Nirgun Swami and all the muktas will come and take you (to Akshardham)." (Four days later on 29 July Prabhudasbhai Patel passed away.)

With all the comforts and amenities provided by the modern world, it is often easy to lose oneself in these pleasures. Yet, on the morning of the Murti Pratishtha ceremony in Houston, six individuals renounced these pleasures of the world to live according to the words of God. These six intelligent and talented youth were given diksha, or were initiated into the sadhu-fold.

Prior to Swamishri's morning puja, a Vedic mahapuja was conducted to commence the initation ceremony. Immediately after Swamishri completed his puja, the rituals continued when Swamishri sanctified their janoi. After this, they were given the customary new kanthi, upper cloth, and pagh by senior saints, and Swamishri applied chandan and gave them the guru mantra and their new name.

One youth, Dipam Patel (BBA) was given Bhagwati Diksha, or saffron garments, and was given the name Sadhu Gnanmunidas. The remaining five youth were given Parshadi Diksha, or white garments. Yogen Patel (BA in Economics) was given the name Janak Bhagat, Yogi Patel (BA in Economics) was given the name Harishchandra Bhagat, Dhaval Trivedi (MA in Management Information Systems) was given the name Parikshit Bhagat, Anush Patel (BA in Finance) was given the name Dhruv Bhagat, and Rahul Patel (JD) was given the name Virat Bhagat.

Swamishri blessed the new initiates and commended their parents for sacrificing their sons, some of whom gave up their only children, and some gave up both sons. He stated that the new initiates, instead of helping just a few or the local community, would inspire hundreds and thousands to follow the path of God.

A culmination of years of hard work, and three days of rituals, Swamishri completed the inauguration of the first Shikharbad Mandir in America by performing the Murti Pratishtha ceremony. In this ceremony, Swamishri transformed a spectacular and beautiful work of art into a divine house of God by requesting God to reside eternally within the murtis.

After the Mahapuja Vidhi was conducted within the Mandir itself, Swamishri arrived through a majestic swan gate to the accompaniment of rhythms provided by the Akshar Dhwani Band. Balaks dressed in traditional attire lined the pathway to the Mandir to receive Swamishri.

Upon entering the Mandir, Swamishri performed all the Vedic rituals for the Pratishtha. He gave blessings immediately after this ceremony, in which he emphasized that the deities are not mere statues, but are God incarnate, and countless will be blessed by their darshan. Finally, Swamishri performed the first aarti of the murtis before leaving the Mandir.
Also, for the first time ever, devotees all over the world had darshan of this Murti Pratishtha ceremony through a live television broadcast.

ds.t: Nothing is understood in a rush
w: Monday, 25 July 2005 (Ashadh vad 5, Samvat 2061), Bochasan

A devotee came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He lived in London. After going to London he had come into contact with satsang and become very firm in it, but his brother living here still did not even believe in God. Speaking of this, he said, "This elder brother of mine just keeps saying there is no such thing as God. However much we argue, he says to us, 'Have you seen Him?' Saying this, he cuts off our arguments. He would not come here either, but I told him, 'Just once have darshan of Pramukh Swami. After that, if you do not want to come to the mandir, don't.'" Hearing him, Swamishri patiently said to the elder brother, "Even if you just come and sit in the spiritual discourses, you will understand whether God exists or not. With one foot in the stirrup, nothing can be understood of the teaching of Brahman." Then, giving simple, natural arguments, Swamishri said, "How does this rain fall? How does the sun rise regularly? God's creation is so extraordinary. It is because of God that our intellect works too. Scientists also say the same. The endless wonders that we see are all God's doing. From a human comes a human. From an animal comes an animal. How does all this happen? If you think about just this much, you will realise that there is something like God. That we move and walk now is because of the atma within. If that atma leaves, even though we would be the very same, we could not do anything at all. So who is the one who directs it? If God were not within us, we could not speak or move, we could not even move a hand. Because God exists, we exist. You speak and I like it, I speak and you like it; all this is because God is within. Otherwise, if the atma leaves from within, even if it is our own brother, we do not keep him." At Swamishri's simple arguments, based on the Vachanamrut, the unbeliever melted. More than the arguments, Swamishri's faith affected him deeply, and he came out wearing a kanthi.

After Thakorji’s darshan, Swamishri performed his morning puja in his room. At 10.00 a.m. Swamishri proceeded towards the festival assembly held nearby on the mandir ground. The main theme of the assembly was “Guru guna apãr hai” – the guru’s virtues are innumerable. The celebration assembly programme was as follows: The glory and meaning of Guru Purnima – speech by Anandswarup Swami Couplets written by Brahmanand Swami – sung by Aksharesh Swami and Madhurvadan Swami The guru’s virtues are innumerable – speech by Viveksagar Swami Gurudev mero ghãt dusaro banãyo – couplets sung by sadhus Transformations of people’s lives by Swamishri – speech by Tyagvallabh Swami Incidents of devotees blessed with spiritual realization by Swamishri – speech by Kothari Swami How Swamishri consolidates faith in all – speech by Ishwarcharan Swami Kon aesi bhet gururãj ãge dhariye – couplets sung by sadhus How to perform guru pujan of Swamishri – speech by Mahant Swami Swamishri was honoured with garlands by senior sadhus.

Swamishri inaugurated a video: ‘Swaminarayan Satsang Darshan, Part 105’. Swamishri inaugurated a publication by Swaminarayan Aksharpith, ‘Prasangam’ 2008, Guru malyã gunavãlã – kirtan sung by Krishnapriya Swami.

Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly of 65,000 devotees, “The glory of guru is sung abundantly in India. Through the guru we realize spiritual knowledge and attain moksha. The guru shows us the right path. Only after meeting a true Sadhu do we learn about how to worship God. The reasons are that he is always absorbed in God, his actions are for the welfare of all and he wishes for the good of all souls. There is a need for schools and colleges in our world and we attain something good when we learn from school teachers and professors. But they cannot teach us about or give us moksha. Only a true Sadhu can redeem us from our infatuation and attachment to wordly objects and pleasures.” The assembly concluded at 11.35 a.m.

While Pramukh Swami Maharaj was taking his walk, his right knee clicked. As the cartilage of the knee got caught between the two joints, the area around the knee became swollen. Because Swamishri had been jolted, he felt a sharp shooting pain, so he could not take a single step. He stood still right where he was. The walk was cancelled and Swamishri was seated on his bed. In old age such physical limitations often get in the way, yet Swamishri never tires of travelling. This is Swamishri's compassion.
